blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu will continue to see cloudy skies, rain showers and thunderstorms through the weekend as a low-pressure area (LPA) embedded along the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) affects the Visayas. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) Visayas Regional Services Division (VISPRSD) forecast cloudy skies with rain showers and thunderstorms over Metro Cebu and the rest of the province from Friday, Sept. 18, through Monday, Sept. 21.
